verdict.rationale: Authy documents encrypted cloud backup for when you lose your phone, multi-device sync, and adding new devices via SMS, voice or existing-device approval, so tokens can be restored on a new phone. A hands-on report confirms restoring access after a pickpocketed phone with a replacement SIM. However, another user lost all their tokens after upgrading phones because porting was not automatic, which suggests the transfer depends on backups being set up beforehand rather than happening in one guided step. Missing for 10: documentation of a single guided new-phone transfer flow, and evidence that transfer works without prior backup setup.

support.subject: As an everyday user, moving to a new phone transfers all my tokens in one guided step

citations.quote: Use our backup feature incase you lose your phone. We encrypt your data, and only decrypt on the devices using a password only you know.
